name: DEFICIT
description:
Every full $1,000,000,000 added to the U.S. Total Public Debt Outstanding (Treasury's Debt to the Penny) since the previous business day's reading is one unit. Remainders under $1B carry forward only across consecutive increases; a day the debt falls or stays flat counts nothing and resets the remainder to zero. On each day with units, the burn_receipts program spends 1 - 0.98^units of the token's burn pool (its fee account: the token's creator-fee SOL plus a disclosed seed, less a 0.02 SOL reserve; while the platform's pre-audit cap stands, of at most 25 SOL of it) buying $DEFICIT on the token's Raydium CPMM pool, and burns every token it receives in the same instruction. A day whose spend is under the floor fixed at launch (about $1 of SOL) buys nothing and the pool keeps the SOL; one crank spends at most 2% of the CPMM pool's SOL reserve and carries the rest to the next crank. The program never sells and has no instruction that moves the pool's SOL or tokens anywhere but that swap and burn.

Rule: 2% of the burn pool per unit; rules sha256 8e3e8b66748a7630b9fe0e9793583434a076f2a03e335cad3d4c965758a15be9. Memecoin: the rule says what supply does, not what price does. Not advice.
